name: global_state
command: test ! -e /tmp/dlink-phase6a && test ! -L /tmp/dlink-phase6a && test ! -e /etc/dropbear && printf "Temporary tree absent; original key directory still absent\n"; id -u; awk '$2=="/" && $3=="jffs2" {print $2,$3,$4}' /proc/mounts

name: original_services
command: for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -r "$d/comm" ] || continue; n=$(cat "$d/comm"); case "$n" in dropbear|telnetd) printf '%s %s\n' "${d##*/}" "$n";; esac; done; netstat -lnt | awk 'NR<3 || $4 ~ /:(22|23|2222)$/'
